description:
**About the company**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.

We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Finance and Planning team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**About the role**

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to help own **US Payroll**. You'll work on the features that make sure every US employee and contractor is paid accurately and on time, and that taxes, deductions and benefits are handled correctly. It's a role for someone early in their product career who wants to go deep into a hard, high-stakes domain and grow fast.

**What you'll do**

  

* Own features across the US payroll run: pay schedules, regular and off-cycle payrolls, approvals, payroll funding and data checks that keep payroll on time.
* Work on tax setup, employee and contractor tax documents (W-2, 1099), deductions and garnishments.
* Help improve integrations with benefits providers (such as 401(k) and health insurance) and accounting tools (such as QuickBooks).
* Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work closely with Engineering and Design to ship reliable features.
* Talk to US payroll admins and customers. Understand their workflows and pain points and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Work with CX, Implementation and Support to understand escalations, find root causes, and fix recurring themes for good.
* Work with partner teams to understand their APIs and behaviour, and raise and track issues that affect our customers.
* Define success metrics for what you ship, track adoption and correctness, and improve based on data.

**What you'll bring**

  

* 1–2 years of experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis or a similar role in B2B SaaS. Strong freshers with relevant internships are welcome to apply.
* Any exposure to **finance, fintech, payments, accounting, payroll or HR tech** is a strong plus. So is any work with US customers or US-market products.
* A CA, CA-Inter, CPA, CFA or finance degree is a bonus but not required.

*Domain & customer*

* **Curious about money, tax and how payroll works:** you enjoy understanding the rules behind how people get paid, and you want to go deep, not just manage tickets.
* **Learns fast:** you've picked up something complex quickly before, and can explain it simply to others.
* **Customer-led thinking:** you're comfortable talking to users, asking good questions, and finding the real problem behind a request.

*Product craft*

* **Attention to detail:** in payroll, small mistakes matter. You think through edge cases and write clear acceptance criteria.
* **Structured thinking:** you can break a messy problem into clear parts, prioritise, and explain your reasoning.
* **Comfortable with data:** basic SQL, spreadsheets or dashboards. You like checking whether something actually worked after launch.
* **Clear communication:** you write crisply and can keep engineering, design, support and customers on the same page.

*Engineering partnership*

* **Technically curious:** you're comfortable reading API documentation and understanding how data moves between systems, or you're keen to learn quickly.
* **Owns quality:** you test what you ship, and when something breaks, you help find the root cause and push for a lasting fix.
* **A good partner to Engineering:** you work through disagreements with evidence and customer outcomes, and you're open to changing your mind.

*Ways of working*

* **Uses AI tools** to learn faster, research, and work more efficiently.
* **Open to working with US customers and partners,** including some calls in US hours when needed.

* Product ownership: Experience identifying customer needs through data and research, prioritising problems to solve based on business and customer value, and owning products from discovery through to post-launch optimisation.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* AI Knowledge: Understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI products, including awareness of the governance, risk, and control frameworks required to deliver these solutions safely and responsibly

description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

### **What you'll do:**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. At FOXO, you'll work directly with the founders, designers, engineers, doctors, and business teams to identify consumer problems, shape product direction, and take ideas from discovery to launch. You'll use customer insights and data to make decisions, improve user experiences, and drive measurable product outcomes.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap. You'll help build one. We're looking for someone with strong product judgment, an analytical mindset, and the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Own product initiatives end to end:** Drive problem discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and post-launch improvements.
* **Build great mobile experiences:** Improve onboarding, navigation, user journeys, and the overall experience of using a consumer app.

* **Drive product direction:** Work with the founders to shape the roadmap and prioritize problems based on customer needs and business impact.
* **Partner with Design and Engineering:** Translate problems into clear user flows, product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* **Use data to drive decisions:** Analyse funnels, cohorts, activation, engagement, and retention to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement.
* **Experiment and iterate:** Test ideas, evaluate outcomes, and continuously improve the product based on evidence.
* **Drive execution:** Make trade-offs, resolve bottlenecks, coordinate releases, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work with doctors and business teams to translate domain expertise into useful consumer experiences.
* **Explore AI opportunities:** Identify where AI can meaningfully improve the user experience or solve a real consumer problem.

Must Have

* 4–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably in B2C or consumer internet.
* Experience at a consumer internet company building products used directly by consumers, where engagement, retention, or growth mattered.
* Strong understanding of mobile app fundamentals, including onboarding, user journeys, navigation, funnels, and repeat usage.

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

7 years

Master's Degree

Full Time

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

---------------------

title: Senior Product Manager (POS, Retail)
description:

experience, and business outcomes for Ginesys’s POS portfolio across Cloud POS, Offline

expertise with strong product craft to modernise a mission-critical store platform and shape

the future of intelligent store commerce.

**Overview**

Role: **Product Manager II**

Help millions of people discover why Copilot is worth paying for.

Copilot is becoming the AI companion people reach for at work, and more and more of those moments happen on a phone. Every day, people discover something new Copilot can do for them. Your job is to make sure that, when they are ready for more, the path to a paid plan is clear, helpful and genuinely valuable. You will own real experiments on a product used around the world, learn fast and see your work land with customers in weeks, not years.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, with chat, agents and creation in a single experience. Monetization is moving inside the product, where value is felt. Early signals on mobile are strong, and in-app purchase is now live on iOS and Android. It is an exciting moment to join: the patterns for monetizing AI are being invented now.

How we work

* Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if…

* You would rather own the outcome, good or bad, than be shielded from it.
* You love turning data and customer insight into a sharp idea worth testing.
* You form a view, test it quickly and update it when the data disagrees.
* You thrive with high ownership and ask for help early.
* You already use AI to work faster and keep exploring what else it can do.
* Shipping often sounds energizing, not exhausting.

This role may not be for you if…

* You want a fully specified plan handed to you every quarter.
* You prefer long studies to running a test and learning from it.
* You measure success by features launched rather than customers who find value.

This is a chance to shape how AI is experienced and valued by people around the world, early in your career and at real scale. You will learn alongside a fast-moving, AI-native team, own outcomes from day one and grow quickly. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, we would love to meet you.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Build the commerce engine that powers Copilot's growth.

Every great growth idea, a new offer, a smarter trial, a better upgrade, ends in the same place: a purchase that has to feel effortless and work flawlessly, on every device. You will own the commerce foundations behind Copilot, so that anyone who chooses to pay gets instant access to what they bought, and growth teams can turn a new idea into a live offer in days. This is a growth role disguised as a platform role: the systems you build decide how fast the whole organization can learn.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, for consumers and businesses alike. Monetization is moving inside the product, with new plans, add-ons and usage-based offers arriving quickly. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is live across iOS and Android. description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of global liquidity by helping deliver modern, client-first capabilities at scale. Join a team where you will partner across product, technology, and operations to turn complex needs into delivered outcomes. Bring your product and analysis expertise to a role with strong visibility, growth opportunities, and mobility across a global payments organization.

As a Product Vice President at JPMorganChase within Payments, Liquidity and Account Solutions Product Development, you will drive delivery of money market fund capabilities as part of a multi-year liquidity platform transformation. You will act as a primary liaison between product owners and technology delivery teams to define clear requirements and enable predictable execution. You will translate current-state behaviors and client needs into a prioritized backlog of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You will partner with engineering, operations, user experience, and business stakeholders to deliver agreed milestones with strong quality and risk discipline. You will help ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned to evolving market and regulatory expectations.

This role supports a global initiative modernizing liquidity and account services for large multinational corporate and financial institution clients. The work spans multiple regions and stakeholder groups and requires strong coordination across product, technology, and operational partners. You will help close current-state gaps while defining a clear target state that supports faster product innovation and improved client experience. Success will be measured through delivery of prioritized capabilities, clarity of documentation, and effective stakeholder alignment. Coverage flexibility is required to support United States business hours through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with occasional extension based on critical delivery needs.

Job Responsibilities

* **Develop** deep domain knowledge of liquidity and money market fund offerings, including client workflows, constraints, and value drivers.
* **Lead** cross-functional execution across product, engineering, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver committed milestones.
* **Analyze** existing processes and documentation to understand current-state behavior and identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* **Define** target-state requirements using clear artifacts such as epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This position may be a hybrid or fully remote position, as decided by your manager. At GoDaddy, we are driven by our mission to make opportunity more inclusive. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager to join our Risk Services team in India. This role offers the flexibility of remote work alongside in-person collaboration.

As a Senior PM on the Risk Services team, you'll have the outstanding opportunity to build trust across GoDaddy’s brands, products, and services. We aim to protect our customers, partners, and vendors from bad actors and help prevent, detect, and recover from financial, reputational, and customer data loss. * Defining requirements and the roadmap for platform and internal tools supports low reaction time, coverage, and precision. This helps meet the needs of an ever-changing risk landscape.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/other technical/engineering field or equivalent applicable experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management or equivalent capability for an eCommerce web services product.
* Experience applying strong business insight and technical vision for a product area and using both technical and operational capabilities to build solutions.
* Demonstrated success managing medium to large complex projects in an eCommerce setting.
* Proficiency with web services, generative and agentic AI, and API development, with a curiosity to always learn more in this ever-changing technical landscape.

**You might also have...**

* Master's degree in a technology or business-related field, or equivalent experience.
* Direct experience in risk management or payments within a large-scale eCommerce setting.
* Experience bringing to bear rules engine and machine learning techniques for anomaly detection.

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

description:

Business Area: Investing and Lending

Area of Expertise: Investment Banking

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131619

  

Join us as Senior Product Manager - APAC, where you will be responsible for the development and oversight of our loan and overdraft products across India, broader Asia and the Middle East. You will work closely with loan originators and broader stakeholders across the region, including coordinating new product approvals, performing annual product reviews, and acting as the business product owner in the region to help prioritise technology and process changes. You will also work closely with Operations and Technology on the rollout of our strategic loan platform across the region. The role will sit with our Investment Banking Origination team in Mumbai and report jointly to the Global Head of Loan Product Management and the Global Head of Loan Transformation.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

Be a strong and ambitious candidate at Vice President level with strong product management, business analysis, stakeholder management and loan product knowledge, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  
  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to capture key requirements.
* Strong bilateral and syndicated loan product knowledge.
* Strong communication, relationship management and networking skills.
* Strong product management skills.
* Ability to capture key requirements and summarise them into management-style presentations and proposals.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive process improvements.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Good presentation and PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of process design, optimisation and ownership, with a focus on client outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to product ownership models within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and controls within lending processes.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:

* Contributing to and influencing policies and procedures for the function, and planning, managing and consulting on multiple complex and critical strategic projects which may be business-wide.
* Providing expert advice to business and functional management and committees to influence decisions.
* Escalating breaches of policies and procedures appropriately.
* Fostering and guiding compliance, ensuring regulations are observed and relevant processes are in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focusing on the external environment, regulators or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Maintaining broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within the relevant discipline, alongside up-to-date sector and functional knowledge and insight into external market developments and initiatives.
* Negotiating with and influencing stakeholders at a senior level, both internally and externally.
* Acting as a principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions and business divisions.
* Acting as a mandated spokesperson for the function and business division.
  

  

Job location is Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To develop and manage the wholesale lending products and services, collaborating with, and ensuring service standards are complied with by, business partners across the bank, including investment bankers, credit analysts, risk managers, and operations professionals, to ensure that our products meet the needs of the bank's clients and are aligned with the bank's overall strategic objectives whilst ensuring all governance, control, regulatory and legal requirements are met.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of product strategy for financial products and services offered within the wholesale division. .
* Identification of investments opportunities and customer needs to create new products or enhance existing ones. .
* Management of the entire product lifecycle, including product planning, development, launch, and ongoing management, including oversight of service levels. .
* Analysis of market data to make informed decisions regarding product positioning and pricing. .
* Assessment and management of risks associated with lending products and implement risk mitigation strategies, including the operation of and attendance to governance forums. .
* Oversight of regulatory and technological change.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The team owns a diverse portfolio including Reputation Management, Dashboard & Reporting, Blogging, Social Planner, Email Marketing, Chat Widget, Affiliate Manager, Template Library, Brand Boards, and other growth-focused products.
  
  
Reputation Management is a strategic investment area for HighLevel, focused on helping businesses build trust, improve local visibility, and accelerate growth through customer reviews. Our vision is to evolve the product from a review management solution into an AI-powered reputation growth platform that enables businesses to generate more reviews, automate engagement, respond intelligently to customer feedback, and gain actionable insights that strengthen their online presence at scale.

**CORE AREAS OF OWNERSHIP**

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap :** Define the vision, strategy, north-star metrics, and 12–18 month roadmap for Reputation Management. Drive prioritization, investment decisions, and business outcomes.

* **Review Growth** : Drive review acquisition through automated campaigns, multi-channel requests, personalization, experimentation, and conversion optimization.

* **Reputation Automation :** Create automation-first workflows for review requests, sentiment-based routing, escalations, notifications, and proactive engagement.

* **Product Discovery & Customer Research :** Lead customer interviews, workflow audits, usability testing, competitive analysis, and market research to identify opportunities and validate solutions.

* **7+ years** in product management, scaling 0-1 products, B2B SaaS experience or building any AI agentic products.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency:

  + Comfortable partnering with Engineering/Data on data flows, instrumentation, system design, and reliability

* Proven track record of moving business metrics (retention, expansion, adoption, support deflection, engagement)
* Demonstrated ability to lead without authority, influence cross-functional partners, and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Data, and GTM
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can create crisp narratives for executives and individual contributors

**FIRST 12 MONTHS: HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED**

* **0–3 months: Foundation.** Validate customer problems, set baseline metrics, and get a prioritized 12–18 month roadmap approved.
* **3–6 months: Growth & AI adoption.** Launch AI review replies and expand automation, increasing review volume, response rates, and engagement.
* **6–12 months: Intelligent reputation platform.** Ship advanced automations, AI insights, enterprise multi-location support, and analytics, making Reputation Management a key driver of growth and retention.

title: Senior Software Product Manager
description:
### **About Us**

Phenom Cloud is not your average consultancy. HR is our home turf: we help clients solve their trickiest people-tech puzzles with smart, innovative solutions, backed by strong partnerships with leading HR technology vendors. Our clients operate in complex, highly regulated industries such as advanced manufacturing, life sciences, pharma, retail, and financial services, where "trusted relationship" is a real requirement, not a buzzword in a pitch deck.

What really sets us apart is our people. We know our stuff, we don't take ourselves too seriously, and yes, we are genuinely fun to be around (our clients said so, and we didn't even pay them). Through it all, we keep client excellence at the heart of everything we do. We are not a quick fling: we are a reliable, credible partner who remembers our clients' birthdays, shows up on time, and is still around years later.

### **Position Summary**

If that sounds like your kind of place, and you're a product leader who loves turning great ideas into great software (and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves to make it happen), we should talk.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Product Management** professional to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of Phenom Cloud's expanding portfolio of enterprise software products, including innovative AI-powered solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages roadmaps, attends sprint reviews, and asks engineering for status updates. We need someone who takes real ownership, understands how software actually works, knows what customers need, and can turn product challenges into opportunities.

You'll have end-to-end accountability for product strategy, quality, prioritization, and delivery. That means quickly understanding our existing products, identifying what needs improvement, establishing clear priorities, and working closely with engineering to turn requirements into software that actually delivers.

But this isn't just about making products work better. It's about making them more valuable. You'll study the market, understand competitors, identify opportunities for differentiation, and help shape products customers genuinely want to buy.

You'll work directly with executive leadership, collaborate across product and engineering teams, and have meaningful influence over the direction of our software business. We're a growing company, so expect to wear multiple hats. If your ideal role involves a large team handling all the details while you focus exclusively on strategy, this probably isn't your gig.

**For the right entrepreneurial product leader, this is a rare opportunity to take real ownership, make a visible impact, and help scale an innovative software portfolio without navigating layers of corporate bureaucracy.**

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, quality, prioritization, and overall success of Phenom Cloud's software product portfolio
* Quickly assess existing products, identify functional gaps and usability issues, and drive improvements that make a real difference to customers
* Establish clear product priorities, balancing critical fixes, customer needs, technical considerations, and strategic enhancements
* Lead and coordinate product management activities, providing direction, accountability, and oversight across the product lifecycle
* Partner closely with engineering to translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Drive agile execution through sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and release readiness. We're big fans of shipping great software, not just talking about it
* Ensure delivered functionality meets requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations
* Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for innovation, differentiation, and commercial growth
* Develop and execute product roadmaps that connect customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives
* Collaborate with customers, sales, marketing, and delivery teams to gather feedback, shape product direction, and support go-to-market activities
* Identify opportunities to expand product capabilities, introduce new offerings, and grow recurring software revenue
* Establish practical, scalable product management processes without turning a fast-moving company into a bureaucracy

### **Skills & Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in software product management, technical product ownership, or a closely related role
* Proven experience managing software products through requirements, development, testing, release, and continuous improvement
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint management, backlog prioritization, and software development lifecycles
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Strong technical aptitude and the confidence to challenge engineering assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and get into the details when needed
* Experience diagnosing product issues, prioritizing improvements, and driving problems through to resolution
* Strong commercial instincts and the ability to connect product strategy with customer needs, competitive positioning, and business growth
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when things aren't neatly documented or clearly defined
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, establish accountability, and keep development moving without needing a small army of project managers
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action. You'd rather solve a problem than schedule another meeting to discuss it
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage confidently with engineers, customers, and executives alike
* Ability to use AI to improve productivity and accelerate product development without sacrificing independent thinking, creativity, or sound judgment
* A genuinely great teammate who is collaborative, approachable, and fun to work with. We value smart people with small egos and a sense of humor

### **Some Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or subscription-based products
* Background in HR technology, learning management systems, talent management, or workforce technology
* Experience with AI-powered products, workflow automation, or enterprise software integrations
* Track record of launching, scaling, or commercializing software products
* Experience leading product owners, product managers, or cross-functional development teams
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools
* Experience in a startup, scale-up, or entrepreneurial software environment where wearing multiple hats comes with the territory

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401K)
* Remote working
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Opportunity to take full ownership of a growing software portfolio and directly influence product strategy, innovation, and commercial success
* Direct access to executive leadership and meaningful influence over the growth and direction of our software business
* Career growth opportunities as our software portfolio and product organization continue to scale
* Creative, entrepreneurial environment where decisions happen quickly, great ideas are encouraged, and bureaucracy is kept to a minimum
* Surround yourself with people who are great at what they do and even better at not taking themselves too seriously

title: Sr. Product Manager I
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager I to own the integrations and agentic ecosystem for Brandfolder, Smartsheet's Digital Asset Management platform. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product area. It covers how Brandfolder connects to the tools where marketing and creative teams work, and how AI agents find, use and govern brand content through MCP, connectors, APIs and partner integrations.

Your work will determine whether Brandfolder is the trusted source of brand content for people and AI agents alike. This is an individual contributor role for a product leader with strong technical fluency, deep customer instincts and the confidence to drive a complex, cross-surface product area across multiple engineering teams and external partners.

**You Will**
------------

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Brandfolder's MCP server, connector framework, public API and integrations and make clear prioritization and sequencing decisions
* Define how AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot discover, retrieve, create and update brand assets, while keeping permissions, usage rights and brand governance intact
* Lead the evolution of Brandfolder's integration portfolio
* Define the API and agent-readiness strategy: authentication, scopes, rate limits, webhooks, tool design and developer experience for customers, partners and AI clients
* Own the quality, reliability and supportability of existing integrations, and shape the migration path from legacy connectors to the new platform
* Lead customer and partner discovery sessions to validate assumptions
* Author crisp product briefs, requirements and technical specs that design and engineering can execute without ambiguity, from discovery through GA and post-launch
* Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM, Customer Success, Support and partner teams
* Define success metrics for every feature, such as integration adoption, active accounts, agent task success, API usage and work with data teams to ensure instrumentation from day one
* Represent product in leadership reviews, MBRs, partner conversations and customer engagements
* Contribute to packaging and pricing decisions for integrations and AI capabilities

**You Have**
------------

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering high-impact features in enterprise SaaS or B2B software
* Experience owning platform, API, integration, connectors or developer-facing product areas, including how products work with AI models and agents is a strong plus
* Experience with content, digital asset management, marketing technology or workflow products is a plus
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces and make clear scoping and sequencing decisions across multiple engineering teams and external partners
* A working understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, role-based permissions), APIs and webhooks, and data security considerations for AI
* Strong customer instincts: you run structured discovery, synthesize signal and turn it into well-scoped, validated decisions
* A track record of excellent product briefs, requirements and specs that engineering acts on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM and Customer Success, including third-party partner dependencies
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption, funnel, quality and reliability metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. title: Senior Staff Product Manager
description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.

1. Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.

2. Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.

3. Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.

6. Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.

7. Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.

8. Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.

9. Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.

10. Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Team's Impact**

The Analytics API & MCP Platform team is responsible for delivering FactSet's analytics capabilities through scalable APIs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. The team enables clients, partners, and internal applications to access portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk, and investment insights through modern integration channels including APIs, Power BI, Snowflake, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) applications.

Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and scalable experiences that help clients integrate FactSet analytics into their workflows, applications, and AI-powered solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Associate Product Manager partners with clients, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve customer problems, and deliver impactful product outcomes. This role supports the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, execution, launch, adoption, and ongoing product optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with a product mindset and is passionate about APIs, developer experiences, data integration platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Gather and analyse feedback from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and product opportunities.

* Participate in product discovery activities, market research, and validation of new product concepts.

* Help define success metrics and measure product outcomes.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Define and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.

* Support prioritization of enhancements, client requests, defects, and technical improvements.

* Participate in testing, release validation, and post-release monitoring to ensure product quality.

**Analytics API & MCP Platform Ownership**

* Develop deep expertise in Analytics APIs, MCP solutions, developer workflows, and platform capabilities.

* Support client onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Analytics API and MCP solutions.

* Troubleshoot product, integration, entitlement, authentication, and configuration issues.

* Act as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams.

**Adoption, Monitoring & Enablement**

* Monitor usage, client adoption, and key product health metrics.

* Help improve product instrumentation, analytics, and reporting capabilities.

* Create and maintain product documentation, knowledge base content, release communications, and onboarding materials.

* Support internal training and client enablement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, Support, and Client Success teams to deliver successful outcomes.

* Contribute ideas that improve processes, product quality, scalability, and client experience.

Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset.  



**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, Business Analysis, Financial Technology, or a related role.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA and working knowledge on Python preffered

* Understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, and developer workflows.

* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools (e.g., Postman).

* Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation.

* Experience supporting integrations with **Power BI** , **Snowflake** , or similar analytics and data platforms.

* Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications.

Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows.  



**Key Competencies**

**Insights**

* Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions.

**Strategy**

* Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy.

**Execution**

* Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Technical Expertise**

* Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.

**Career Progression**

**Product Specialist Senior Product Specialist Associate Product Manager Product Manager Senior Product Manager**

  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.
  

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Product Lead – Skills**

1. Strong domain and business knowledge in relevant product, operations, and technology areas.

2. Experience working with agile product delivery teams across multiple squads.

3. Strong knowledge of backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and dependency management.

4. Ability to assess business value, urgency, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

5. Experience using Jira, ESM, dashboards, and reporting tools for backlog and delivery visibility.

6. Strong stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, SMEs, and business teams.

7. Ability to translate product strategy and business needs into actionable priorities for squads.

8. Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience coaching or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar roles.

10. Understanding of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, technical debt, production support, and continuous improvement.

11. Ability to work effectively in a complex environment with high request volumes and competing priorities.

12. Understanding of agile principles, product operating models, and governance practices.

**Product Lead – Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Act as the domain-level product lead for a defined area, such as Core, Print, or Voting/Tabulation/Edit Load.

2. Translate Product Manager strategy, roadmap priorities, and business objectives into clear direction for Product Owners and squads.

3. Support prioritization and sequencing of work across squads, including discretionary initiatives, run/OCC work, lite requests, regulatory work, production support, and technical debt.

4. Review incoming requests for business value, urgency, timelines, dependencies, impacted squads, capacity implications, and governance needs.

5. Ensure requests are categorized and prioritized using agreed criteria, such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low.

6. Work with Product Owners to align squad backlogs with domain priorities, roadmap commitments, and available capacity.

7. Guide Product Owners on backlog quality, requirement readiness, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and dependency management.

8. Participate in key business and refinement discussions for complex, high-priority, cross-squad, or high-risk initiatives.

9. Ensure appropriate SME involvement for discovery, technical clarification, spikes, and requirement validation.

10.Coordinate with Delivery Managers, Engineering leaders, QA leads, SMEs, and Scrum Masters on delivery constraints, dependencies, and sequencing impacts.

11. Maintain visibility into domain-level capacity, delivery risks, blockers, resource constraints, and impacts to roadmap commitments.

12. Identify and escalate priority conflicts, major trade-offs, cross-squad dependencies, and delivery risks to the Product Manager when needed.

13. Support domain intake reviews, backlog reviews, prioritization discussions, and governance preparation.

14. Provide regular domain-level updates on priorities, progress, risks, capacity, dependencies, and milestone impacts.

15. Coach and support Product Owners; where needed, directly perform Product Owner responsibilities for specific initiatives, including gathering requirements, creating/refining stories, managing backlog items, and supporting delivery through completion.

title: Senior Product Manager, Associate Satisfaction
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every day, Amazon Customer Service associates help millions of customers around the world. Their ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences depends on feeling supported, empowered, and equipped to succeed.  
  
We are building new ways to understand and improve the associate experience. By listening to associates and combining their feedback with insights from their day-to-day work, we aim to identify what drives satisfaction, recognize emerging challenges, and help leaders take meaningful action.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development of products that help Amazon understand how associates experience their work. You will shape our associate listening strategy, define how we measure satisfaction across key moments in the associate journey, and partner with science and engineering teams to translate feedback into actionable insights.  
This is an opportunity to build new capabilities from the ground up and influence how Amazon improves the experience of its global Customer Service workforce.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for associate listening, satisfaction measurement, and insights capabilities.
* Develop the associate listening strategy, including survey design, question development, feedback collection, and measurement experiences.
* Partner with research and science teams to establish reliable measures of associate satisfaction, engagement, and wellbeing.
* Identify key moments in the associate journey and define how feedback and experience are measured across them.
* Combine associate feedback with operational and contextual data to identify drivers of satisfaction and emerging challenges.
* Partner with engineering and science teams to build scalable products that translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Define product success metrics and evaluate the impact of new capabilities on associate experience and business outcomes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience with survey research, employee listening platforms, Voice of Customer, or experience measurement products.
* Familiarity with survey design, sampling, response bias, and measurement validity.
